CPD: kāraṇa-bhāva, m., the being a cause; phaluppattiyā ~o, Sv-pṭ ll 116, 9 ≠ l 179, 9 ; tassa ~aṃ dassetuṃ, lt-a ll 156, 2 ; mohatamavidhamanassa ~ato anāvaraṇa­ñāṇaṃ moha­ta­ma­vi­dhamanan ti, Sv-pṭ l 5, 11 ; yassa dhammassa ~ato ṭhā­naṃ, lll 228, 2 ; ~ato samādhi­nimittaṃ, 326, 32 ; yogino vā sukhavisesānaṃ ~ena, 345, 2 ; kilesuppattiyā ~ena, Spk lll 2, 22 ; pacchā-uppajjanakānaṃ ~ato kilesā va, Th-a lll 78, 3 ; sam­bhāro pi yathā ciraṃ pavattati evam assa ~ato tas­mā parikkhāro, Vism 35, 6 qu. Sp 551, 6 ; tassa ~ā, Moh 134, 12 ; so hi parassa kiriyāya ~ena hinoti gacchati pa­vat­ta­tîti hetu, Sadd 691, 15 (“ as the reason for another’s ac­tion ”); ~ena Sv-pṭ l 203, 21 ; atthaṃ ~ena paccāmasati, ll 131, 33 ; so saddo ~ena vutto, 427, 31 ; vāhasâti ~ena, Th-a lll 158, 2 ; lokiyā hi dhātuyo ~ena vavatthitā, Vism 485, 3 (“ defined according to their instrumentality ”, Vism-trsl. (Ñm) qu. Vibh-a 76, 26 (“ being defined according to their being the cause ”, Vibh-a-trsl. l 90, hardly correct ) ≠ Moh 126, 29 ; — °‑paccupaṭ­ṭhāna, n., the manifestation as being a cause; itthiliṅganimittakuttâkap­pānaṃ ~aṃ, Vism 447, 8 (kāraṇabhāvasaṅkhātena … paccayabhāvato, Vism-mhṭ ll 95, 14–16 ) (“ as manifested as the reason for ”, Vism-trsl . [Ñm]) qu. As 322, 13 = Abhidh-av 68, 30 = Moh 62, 34 ; — °‑vibhāvana, n., the explaining the fact of being a cause; yathāvuttasamādhi­paṭi­lābhassa ~aṃ, Sv-pṭ lll 326, 28 .

karaṇa-bhūta , mfn., 1. ( t.t.gr. ) being instrument; 2. being cause; — 1. tena samayena hetubhūtena ~ena ca sikkhāpadāni paññāpayanto, Sp 108, 8 = Sv 33, 18 = Ps l 9, 22 = Spk l 11, 23 = Mp l 13, 18 ≠ Ud-a 23, 5 ; Pj ll 44, 12 ; 137, 2 ; cf. O. H. PlND, JPTS XlV 1990: 185-186; — 2. tena sattâhakaraṇīyena ~ena gantuṃ anujānā- mi, Sp 1068, 10 ; cīvarena ~ena āpatti hotī ti, Sp 1384, 26 ; viramati vā etāya ~āya veramhā puggalo ti ... veramaṇī, Ps l 203, 20 ; etāhi ... ~āhi saṃsāra- dukkhaṃ sattehi anuvidhīyati, Vibh-a 77, 3 ; tena sotena hetubhūtena ~ena vā avadhīyati ... sotâvad- hānam, Paṭis-a 13, 2 ; 593, 25 .

kāraṇa-bhūta, mfn. [ ts., cf. SWTF s.v. ] , being the cause; — exeg.: nimittabhūtaṃ yena ~ena, Sv 701, 14 ( ad ye­na, D ll 265, 17 ) = Ja ll 340 , 6 ’ ; nimittabhūtaṃ ~aṃ, Paṭis-a 478, 31 ; ṭhāne ~e, Sv-pṭ l 510, 21 ; jātiyā ca ma­ra­ṇas­sa ca ~e, Ps lV 238, 24 = Mp ll 232, 15 ; ( ad jāti­maraṇa­sambhave, M lll 187, 7 * = A l 142, 18 * ); Mp ll 147, 20 ; āsavānaṃ ~ehi kilesadhammehi, lV 116, 8 ( ad āsavaṭ­ṭhā­ni­yehi, A lV 224, 28 ); phassassa ~esu chasu dvāresu, Ud-a 191, 5 ( ad chasu phassâyatanesu, Ud 28, 7 * ); ~ehi pac­ca­ye­hi nibbattitaṃ, lt-a l 163, 23 ; — ajjhācārena ~ena, Sp 223, 13 ; aṭṭhasatassa ~aṃ, Spk lll 82, 16 ; ( ad aṭṭha­sa­ta­pa­ri­yā­yaṃ, S lV 231, 21 ); so assa atthi ~o ti attajjhāsayo, Ud-a 30, 7 = lt-a l 35, 26 ; petānaṃ dakkhiṇāniyyātane ~āni anus­sara­ṇa­vat­thūni, Pj l 213, 26 ( ignore n. in Ee “i.e. karaṇabh°?”); kāmarāgassa ~ānaṃ ārammaṇadhammā­naṃ, Spk lll 149, 2 ; tena hîti tena … aṅgāre kate ~assa kaṭ­ṭhassa kaṭṭhabhāvo vigacchati, Sadd 599, 13 ; ~aṃ kam­maṃ, Vv-a 22, 19 ; Nidd-a l 323, 25 ; bhava­sampattiyā ~aṃ attano kusalakammaṃ, Vv-a 317, 7 ; 74, 3 ( Ee w.r. ka ‑ °); ~ena puññakammena, Vv-a 304, 27 ( Ee w.r. ka ‑ °); hitan ti tassa ~aṃ puññaṃ, Cp-a 219, 13 ; Vv-a 90, 4 ( Ee w.r. ka‑°); kākena guyha­vacanassa ~ena guyhaṃ, Ja ll 174, 17 ’; ~assa cak­khussa viññāṇaṃ, As 262, 6 ; cittena ~ena, Mp V 78, 2 qu. Paṭis-a 303, 30 ; cīvarena ~ena āpatti hoti, Sp 1384, 26 ( Ee w.r. ka ‑ °); ñāṇena ~ena, Vibh-a 416, 27 ; gahaṇassa ~ā taṇhādiṭṭhiyo, Sv-pṭ l 204, 30 ; savita­kkasavicārass’ eva ~aṃ domanas­saṃ, ll 336, 1 ; imehi ~ehi catūhi dhammehi, Dhp-a l 255, 12 ; catūhi yogehi khemino ~aṃ dhammapari­yāyaṃ, Spk ll 387, 16 ( ad yogakkhemīpariyāyaṃ, S lV 85, 4 ); piyena ~ena, Ja V 224, 35 ’ ( ad piyena te dammi, 220, 15 * ); piyasabhāvena sātasabhāvena ca ~ena, lt-a ll 165, 30 ; pavattāya viññāṇavīthiyā ~āya, lt-a l 24, 12 ; Th-a lll 206, 24 ; Ud-a 209, 28 ; sīlasampadâdīnaṃ ~aṃ viriya­sam­padaṃ, Th-a l 16, 20 ; — Rem.: ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ ku­sa­lan ti (M l 515, 2 ) ~aṃ, Ps lll 226, 19 ( so Be, MS. B in Ee: w.r.; read with Ee, Ce 1926 ārogya-ana­vajjaṭṭhena, cf. Sv 883, 27 foll.; Sv-pṭ lll 81, 22 foll. ).
